jobs.title: Talent Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**


adMarketplace is the largest global marketplace for Native Search advertising. For over 25 years, we’ve connected brands with consumers at the moment they express commercial intent beyond legacy search engines.  

  

Today, our Native Search solutions are exclusively integrated across next\-generation platforms where discovery happens, including web browsers, Buy Now Pay Later apps, and AI chat surfaces. Powered by vector search technology, our platform delivers relevant text and product ads that match consumers with the brands, products, and offers they’re actively seeking.  

  

Our award\-winning culture is grounded in the principles of Curiosity, Collaboration, Creative Conflict, Commitment, and Competitiveness – our 5Cs. These values drive us to turn complexity into clarity and create measurable value for consumers, advertisers, and publishers alike.

##### **The Role**


As a Talent Operations Coordinator at adMarketplace, you'll help ensure our hiring process runs smoothly from opening a role through offer acceptance. You'll partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver an exceptional candidate experience while supporting recruiting operations, reporting, and process improvements.


In addition to supporting day\-to\-day recruiting, you'll help manage our Challenger and Internship Programs, contributing to the growth of our early\-career talent pipeline.

##### **What You'll Do**

**Recruiting Coordination \& Candidate Experience**

* Coordinate video and onsite interviews across candidates, hiring managers, and interview teams.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process.
* Manage interview logistics, including scheduling, travel, onsite support, and candidate communications.
* Build interview plans, scorecards, coordinate interview panels, and ensure timely interview feedback.
* Help coordinate offer administration, background checks, reference checks and new hire Jira tickets.

**Recruiting Operations**

* Maintain job postings, requisitions, and candidate records within the Applicant Tracking System.
* Prepare recruiting reports, executive updates, dashboards and hiring metrics.
* Support recruiting vendors, recruiting technologies, and system administration.
* Maintain recruiting documentation, templates, and operating procedures.
* Handle new hire onboarding and orientation.
* Work with Learning and Development on new hire onboarding plans.

**Programs \& Process Improvement**

* Co\-lead the Challenger (new grad) Program and Internship Program, including recruitment, onboarding, program coordination, and participant experience.
* Track recruiting metrics and identify opportunities to improve hiring efficiency and candidate experience.
* Support cross\-functional Talent Acquisition projects and process improvements.
* Partner with People Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and business leaders to support recruiting initiatives.
* Take on special projects as needed across Talent Acquisition and People Ops.

##### **What You'll Bring**

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, HR, project coordination, or a related field.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* High agency with the ability to anticipate hiring needs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* A positive, engaging presence with the ability to represent adMarketplace to candidates in an enthusiastic, authentic, and professional manner.
* Experience working with an Applicant Tracking System (Teamtailor, Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or similar) is preferred.
* Comfortable using Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, AI and reporting tools to organize and analyze information.
* A proactive mindset with an interest in improving processes and creating operational excellence.


Compensation: $70,000 \- $85,000 \+ Bonus \& Equity

##### **Join Us**


adMarketplace has been named as one of the best places to work in New York City by Built In and Crain’s\- the latter of which have recognized us the past three years straight! AMP is currently experiencing triple digit growth, and it’s never been a better time to join our team!


We offer a robust continuing education program, management training, regular company\-wide lunch and learns, and well\-defined career paths to ensure all our employees have an opportunity to grow.


At adMarketplace, we play to win, but we learn from our setbacks. Our commitment to a collaborative environment means no one succeeds alone, and no one fails alone either.


We know you’ve come to expect comprehensive healthcare, wellness programs, paid time off, commuter benefits, and 401k matching from any company, so it’s a good thing we offer all of that and so much more. adMarketplace offers Summer Fridays, catered lunches, a fully stocked kitchen, ZogSports teams, happy hours and corporate retreats to encourage a strong work/life balance.


No Third Party Recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.


This range represents the low and high end of the base salary someone in this role may earn as an employee of adMarketplace in the New York office. Salaries will vary based on various factors including but not limited to professional and academic experience; training; associated responsibilities; and other business and organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of our total compensation package for employees. Salary decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each hire.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant supports the pastoral staff and daily operations of Church of the Advent Hope by executing defined recurring tasks and completing ad\-hoc assignments delegated by the Lead Pastor and the Pastor for Community Life. This role is an executor — not a strategist, operations director, or department head. The person in this role keeps the engine of the church running by handling inbound communications, coordinating the calendar with the Communications \& Marketing Director, and providing reliable, detail\-oriented support to the staff team.

Core Responsibility Areas

The Executive Assistant has three core responsibility areas. Everything this role does should be traceable back to one of these three buckets.

1\. Communications Triage (inbound)

* Monitor the general church inbox (info@adventhope.org and equivalent aliases) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine inquiries using approved templates; route pastoral, financial, or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate pastor or staff member within one business day.
* Monitor the church voicemail line daily during scheduled work hours. Return routine calls within one business day; forward pastoral\-care calls to the appropriate pastor by end of day.
* Monitor Intercom (website chat) during scheduled work hours. Respond to routine questions; route complex questions to the right staff member.
* Receive and sort physical mail. Log checks and deposit\-ready items for the Bookkeeper; scan and forward time\-sensitive mail to the appropriate staff member.
* Maintain a running log of communications volume (counts by channel, types of inquiries) and report monthly to the Lead Pastor.

2\. Calendar and Schedule Coordination (with Communications \& Marketing Director)

* Maintain the master church calendar (Google Workspace) as the single source of truth for services, events, staff meetings, rentals, and pastoral availability.
* Work weekly with the Communications \& Marketing Director to confirm which events are being marketed, on what schedule, and through which channels (website, email, social). The Executive Assistant owns accuracy of the calendar; the Communications \& Marketing Director owns promotion of it.
* Open and confirm rental bookings on the calendar; coordinate with the Property Manager on room setup needs.
* Schedule and send calendar invites for pastoral staff meetings, board meetings, elders' meetings, and other recurring gatherings.
* Compile information packets for quarterly board meetings — agenda materials, prior minutes, supporting documents — and circulate in advance of the meeting.
* Handle RSVPs, sign\-ups, and registrations for events not handled by Eventbrite self\-service — e.g., baptism and baby dedication preparation, pastoral appointments, Conversations \& Cuisine seating.

3\. Staff Support and Task Execution

* Execute specific tasks assigned by the Lead Pastor or Pastor for Community Life through the shared task system (Todoist). Acknowledge receipt within 1 business day; confirm completion with a brief status update.
* Prepare Sabbath morning support materials: update the lobby announcement board, ensure interest cards and tithe cards are stocked, and stage any printed handouts provided by the Communications \& Marketing Director.
* Attend the weekly staff meeting and the weekly admin meeting (currently Tuesdays and Wednesdays via Zoom). Take notes and circulate action items within 1 business day.
* Compile materials for quarterly board meetings (does not attend the meeting itself); circulate minutes drafted by the Clerk.
* Maintain a simple, well\-organized filing system (Google Drive) for staff documents, vendor records, and church records.
* Order office supplies and Sabbath\-morning consumables (printer supplies, kitchen paper goods) against a pre\-approved budget set by the Lead Pastor.
* Maintain routine vendor relationships for administrative, office\-supply, and software\-subscription vendors — confirm invoices, process renewals, escalate issues. Building vendors, contractors, insurance, and renter relationships remain with the Property Manager.
* Provide administrative support for baptism, baby dedication, wedding, and funeral logistics as directed by a pastor.

Weekly Schedule

The Executive Assistant works a set weekly schedule, Tuesday through Friday, 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (20 hours per week):

* Tuesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Staff meeting attendance; triage weekend email/voicemail backlog; circulate staff meeting action items.
* Wednesday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Admin meeting attendance; calendar review with the Communications \& Marketing Director; weekly task triage.
* Thursday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Process mail; review routine vendor invoices and renewals; respond to ad\-hoc task list; weekly staff coordination.
* Friday: 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM. Sabbath preparation handoff to the Sabbath Coordinator and Support Team Lead; confirm next\-week calendar.

Schedule flexes during Advent, Holy Week, and the start of the church year. Additional hours during these peaks may be approved in advance by the Lead Pastor.

Skills and Qualifications

Required

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in email and phone contexts.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets).
* Comfort learning and using digital tools (current stack includes Salesforce, Zoom, Squarespace, Todoist, Constant Contact, Mowgli, Intercom, Ramp, Proclaim; the Executive Assistant is not expected to administer all of these but will interact with several).
* Ability to use Anthropic Claude as a working tool — Claude will be part of the daily rhythm of this job for drafting, summarizing, triaging, and task execution. Willingness to learn responsible AI use within the church's guidelines is essential.
* Proficient at problem\-solving and getting things done — bias toward action, ability to close out tasks without repeated handholding

jobs.title: Content Producer & Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
Content Producer \& Social Media Coordinator

**Babyface Brows \| Park Slope, Brooklyn**  
**Part\-Time \| 15–25 hours/week \| $20–$24/hour**

**IMPORTANT: Please apply online only. Do not call the studio or stop by in person regarding this position.** All applications must be submitted through this posting. **Applicants who call or stop by to apply will not be considered.** If we think you may be a fit, we’ll reach out to you directly.

**About Babyface Brows**

Babyface Brows is a specialty brow and lash studio in Park Slope, Brooklyn, steps from Barclays Center. We're a growing beauty brand focused on beautiful brows, great lashes, and making every client feel taken care of.

We're looking for a creative, proactive person to help take our content and marketing to the next level.

**The Role**

We're looking for someone who can bring Babyface Brows to life online.

You'll work closely with management to create, organize, and publish engaging content across Instagram, TikTok, and other channels. The role starts hands\-on and content\-focused, with the opportunity to take on more ownership and broader marketing responsibilities as you grow.

**Important Requirement**  
You must have created and posted content before. This can be for a business, personal social media, school, freelance work, a side project, or anything else. We care less about where you made it and more about what you can create.

**What You'll Do**  
Content \& Social

You'll help create and publish content such as:

* Before\-and\-after posts
* Educational carousels
* Reels and TikToks, including skits, trends, and original concepts
* Stories that engage and grow our community
* Behind\-the\-scenes and day\-to\-day studio content
* Other creative content that fits the Babyface brand

You'll also:

* Brainstorm content ideas and stay on top of trends
* Film clients, artists, and day\-to\-day moments at the studio
* Coordinate content shoots and filming days
* Help direct people on camera
* Coordinate with clients and team members for content
* Use tools like CapCut, Canva, or similar platforms for light editing and production
* Keep content consistent, engaging, and on\-brand

**What Success Looks Like**

Success at Babyface is simple: great content that we consistently put out into the world.

You’ll start by working closely with management to increase posting frequency, improve content quality, and bring more creativity to our social channels.

As you get comfortable, the goal is for you to take more ownership of the content calendar, filming, posting, and day\-to\-day execution with less oversight.

**Career Progression**  
This role can grow beyond social media.

As you become more confident and take ownership, there’s an opportunity to expand into broader marketing, including:

* Email marketing and campaigns
* Local partnerships and community outreach
* Brand and influencer collaborations
* Meta and Google advertising
* Marketing campaigns and creative
* Client segmentation, surveys, and marketing analysis
* Eventually helping build and lead a broader marketing function

We’re growing, so the role can grow with you.

**Who We're Looking For**

You don't need years of professional experience. We're more interested in creativity, initiative, good judgment, and a strong eye for content.

We're looking for someone who is:

* Creative and full of ideas
* Comfortable creating short\-form video
* Comfortable filming and directing people
* Proactive and organized
* Able to work independently and take ownership
* Comfortable with Canva, CapCut, or similar tools
* Interested in beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or social media
* Excited to learn and try new things

*If you see something trending and immediately think, "Babyface could do this," we'd probably get along.*

**Compensation \& Benefits**

$20–$24/hour, based on experience and portfolio

* Flexible part\-time schedule
* Employee discount
* Referral program
* Opportunity to increase hours and responsibility as the business grows

**Want to be highly considered?**  
Please include a link to your portfolio or to a piece of content you’re especially proud of somewhere in your application. This can be a social account, Reel, TikTok, video, campaign, or anything else that shows us what you can do.

**Location:** 458 Bergen Street, Brooklyn, NY 11217  
**Work Location:** In person  
**Schedule:** 15–25 hours/week

Pay: $20\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Referral program

Application Question(s):

* Have you created and posted content before? This can be for a business, personal social media, school, freelance work, a side project, or anything else.

Ability to Commute:

* Brooklyn, NY 11217 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Associate (Fixed-Term)

**The Role**
------------



ITHAKA is seeking a highly organized and detail\-oriented Digital Marketing Associate to provide part\-time fixed\-term (temporary) coverage and operational continuity for our digital marketing function. The associate will support ITHAKA's web and digital operations through website maintenance and quality assurance, reporting production, dashboard maintenance, campaign tracking support, paid advertising coordination, and project documentation.



Reporting to the Sr. Director, Channel Marketing, the associate will receive prioritized assignments from the project manager and work with subject matter experts across web, technology, data analytics, design, content marketing, and paid media for review and approvals. This fixed\-term (temporary) role does not own digital strategy, budget allocation, agency or consultant management, or final publishing and measurement decisions; those responsibilities remain with designated ITHAKA leaders and reviewers. Responsibilities will vary based on active campaigns, website needs, and reporting deadlines; the associate is not expected to perform every workstream listed below every week.



This fixed\-term (temporary) assignment is anticipated to begin in September 2026 and continue through April/May 2027\.



ITHAKA has physical offices in New York City and Ann Arbor, Michigan, with employees distributed across the continental United States. At this time, we're not considering candidates who reside outside of the continental U.S.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Conduct website quality assurance using established checklists, including reviewing links, forms, confirmation states, thank you pages, metadata, calls to action, formatting, mobile behavior, basic accessibility requirements, and published updates; document results and follow\-up issues.
* Make pre\-approved, low\-risk CMS updates after training, including updating existing content modules, replacing links or assets, verifying redirects, checking previews, verifying redirects, and preparing or publishing changes according to the established approval process.
* Support implementation and validation of pre\-approved, well\-scoped marketing site backlog items; escalate requests involving strategy, information architecture, custom development, or significant content changes.
* Support SEO and site health monitoring by running Semrush reports, logging broken links or media, documenting metadata and crawl/indexation issues, maintaining the site health backlog, and escalating high\-priority technical or content issues.
* Produce recurring reports by pulling data from approved sources, updating source sheets, assembling charts and screenshots, documenting caveats, and populating reporting deck templates.
* Maintain and quality\-check existing dashboards and reporting tools, including filters, date ranges, labels, calculations, and source links; assist with small, clearly scoped dashboard builds using established requirements or templates.
* Create and quality\-check UTM links and campaign naming; verify landing page links, forms, thank you page behavior, and attribution paths; document discrepancies for the appropriate analytics or tracking owner.
* Support paid advertising operations by maintaining campaign trackers and Asana tasks, collecting weekly status information, quality\-checking URLs and UTMs, organizing briefs and creative links, and documenting launch readiness and campaign status.
* Depending on priorities and available capacity, the Associate may also support approved web testing or other clearly scoped digital projects through QA, status tracking, observation logs, and documentation.
* Maintain project hygiene across active web, reporting, paid, tracking, and dashboard workstreams by keeping owners, statuses, links, standard operating procedures, handoff notes, and return notes current.
* Follow established access, data handling, publishing, and approval processes, and escalate questions, discrepancies, or higher\-risk changes to the designated reviewer or decision\-maker.

**Experience and Skills**
-------------------------


* One or more years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, web production, analytics support, or a related role; relevant internship or project experience may be considered.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to quality\-check digital content, links, forms, naming conventions, dates, filters, and source data.
* Experience working in content management systems and familiarity with website publishing workflows, page previews, redirects, metadata, and basic accessibility practices.
* Experience with WordPress or a comparable CMS is strongly preferred.

Authority Brands Inc. is a leading provider of home services, building brands that support the success of our franchisees, as well as bettering the lives of the homeowners we serve and the people we employ.
  
  

We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and field\-driven Field Marketing Manager to serve as the primary marketing partner for franchise owners across multiple brands. You will translate brand strategy into practical, measurable local execution, helping owners build scalable, healthy marketing plans across the full funnel, from paid digital demand generation to boots\-on\-the\-ground local activity. The ideal candidate combines marketing planning and budget strategy with hands\-on coaching, thrives in a fast\-paced multi\-brand environment, and is passionate about using data, vendor accountability, and field relationships to create measurable business impact.
  
  

**Responsibilities:****Strategic Leadership:**  

* Partner with franchise owners to build scalable annual and quarterly marketing plans aligned to revenue goals, market opportunity, seasonality, operational capacity, and brand growth priorities.
* Guide owners in developing a balanced full\-funnel budget across paid digital, local awareness, lead generation, retention, referral programs, community engagement, and boots\-on\-the\-ground execution.
* Help owners understand recommended investment levels, channel mix, and the relationship between marketing spend, lead volume, booked jobs, average ticket, conversion rates, and revenue performance.
* Translate brand\-level strategy and systemwide priorities into practical local plans owners can execute consistently within their market.
* Oversee and reinforce the local marketing scorecard, including grassroots marketing, community partnerships, referral outreach, neighborhood visibility, local events, and review generation.


**Execution, Optimization \& Measurement:**  

* Track owner performance against approved marketing plans to ensure adoption, execution, and accountability.
* Monitor budget versus actual performance, planned spend, actual spend, lead volume, booked jobs, cost per lead, cost per booked job, conversion rates, revenue contribution, and return on marketing investment.
* Proactively identify performance gaps, underinvestment, overspending, channel inefficiencies, or execution risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Review paid search, Local Services Ads, social advertising, lead aggregators, and local SEO performance against plan with approved digital partners.
* Hold vendor partners accountable for accurate campaign launches, budget pacing, tracking, reporting, optimization recommendations, and alignment with brand standards.
* Help owners diagnose whether performance issues stem from budget, campaign setup, market demand, operational execution, lead handling, or conversion.
* Coach owners and local teams on repeatable boots\-on\-the\-ground routines that drive lead generation, retention, referral growth, and brand awareness.
* Maintain visibility into owner marketing activity through scorecards, dashboards, budget trackers, vendor reporting, and internal planning tools; prepare clear, actionable summaries for owners, leadership, and cross\-functional partners.
* Contribute to playbooks, training materials, templates, and scalable processes that improve owner adoption and drive consistency across the system.


**Field Visits \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**  

* Participate in on\-site field visits with the Franchise Business Coach (35\-40% travel) to align marketing recommendations with local operations, staffing, sales processes, customer experience, and market conditions.
* Use visits to review plan execution, budget pacing, lead handling, conversion opportunities, local brand presence, and owner adoption of recommended actions.
* Document key observations, follow\-up actions, and owner commitments to drive accountability after the visit.
* Collaborate with Franchise Business Consultants, operations, and brand teams, so owners receive consistent, coordinated guidance.


**Requirements:**  

* Minimum 5 years of experience in field marketing, local/multi\-location marketing, or franchise marketing support.
* Strong command of full\-funnel marketing planning and budget management, including paid digital channels (paid search, LSA, paid social, local SEO, lead aggregators) and grassroots/local execution.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - East Coast
jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the East Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the East Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the East Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the East Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Living and located on the Central to East Coast, USA
* Hospitality experience required
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles
* AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands\-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result


**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**



Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.



This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.



If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process \- your recruiter will be able to help.


#### **What's in it for you?**



Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.


#### **Global benefits**



No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:


* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work\-from\-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**



You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

We're an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serv

**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

  

  

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional\-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia\-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36\.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world\-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close\-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back\-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move\-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on\-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make\-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.

A project of Chicago Human Rhythm Project, the Mayfair Arts Center (MAC) is a collaborative effort to foster community growth through rhythmic expression. We aim to offer diverse, high\-quality dance and movement classes to the general public while centralizing the education programs, rehearsal space and informal performances of several core groups, as well as supporting additional emerging companies and independent artists. 14 paid holidays with a end of year holiday refresh break



Health, Vision and Dental Insurance



401K program



Tuition reimbursement program

Term Life Insurance Plan



Standard Disability Plan

 **Job Description:**



The **Customer Experience Account Manager (CXAM)** is responsible for managing the full customer order process—from inquiries and daily order entry to service requests and sales support functions such as CRM updates and sample requests. Acting as a key liaison between customers, the sales team, and internal partners (Logistics, Operations, Credit, and Inventory Planning), the CXAM ensures a seamless and effortless customer experience.



This role requires strong critical thinking, problem\-solving skills, organizational excellence, and the resilience to navigate daily challenges while “owning” the customer relationship in partnership with sales.

  

This position is based at our **Rosemont, IL headquarters**.

* **Process and manage a high volume of complex, multi\-step orders**, serving as the primary owner to ensure accurate and timely execution.
* **Navigate multiple computer systems and platforms** to complete all steps of the order fulfillment process.
* Handle significant volumes of **inbound and outbound communications** (calls, emails, chats) with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring timely and professional responses.
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally** with Sales, Credit, Purchasing, Inventory, Logistics, Warehouse, and Accounting to ensure seamless order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Partner with Sales to **support contract balance reconciliation, forecasting, sample requests, customer events, and issue resolution**, offering solutions and alternatives as needed.
* Work closely with Sales Account Managers to ensure **CRM accuracy, pipeline tracking, and market intelligence gathering**.
* Assist Sales Account Managers with **strategic analysis of customer growth goals** in alignment with Batory Foods’ objectives.
* **Coordinate and support contract submissions** and updates within the CRM system.
* **Troubleshoot issues with critical thinking, business acumen, and professionalism** to resolve complex challenges.
* **Provide cross\-functional support** by covering team responsibilities and collaborating across departments when needed; serve as backup during team absences.
* **Attend meetings and travel as required** to support customer or business needs.
* Perform **other duties as assigned** by management.

  


**Personal Qualifications:**


* Strong commitment to **accuracy and attention to detail**, with an appreciation for organizational structure.
* Demonstrates **initiative and self\-motivation**, taking ownership of tasks without the need for direction.
* Builds and maintains **positive, collaborative relationships** with customers, colleagues, and business partners.
* Consistently maintains a **professional, empathetic, approachable, and polished demeanor** in all interactions.
* Earns trust by demonstrating **competence, reliability, care, clear communication, and follow\-through**.
* Willingness to work **extended hours as needed** to meet business demands.
* Thrives in a **fast\-paced, dynamic environment** where no two days are alike.
* Comfortable in settings that encourage **creative problem\-solving and solution\-oriented thinking**.
* Excels in both **team\-oriented collaboration** and independent work.
* Bachelor’s degree in **Business or Supply Chain/Distribution Management** preferred, or 3\+ years of equivalent experience.
* Proven experience demonstrating **organizational skills, critical thinking, and problem\-solving abilities**.
* Proficient in **Microsoft Office Suite**, with strong **data entry skills** and intermediate\-level **Excel expertise**.

  



Batory Foods in an equal opportunity employer which considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, Batory Foods also provides “reasonable accommodations” to qualified individuals with disabilities, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state and local laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, please notify us immediately.

jobs.description:
**Who is O\&K American Corp?**


We have been supplying high\-quality cold heading steel wire to our customers for over 100 years! Through continuous innovation, a proactive approach to challenges, and the expertise of our exceptional team, we consistently deliver quality products that meet the highest standards. Our facilities are located in Chicago, IL and Seymour, IN.

 **Would you like to join the O\&K Team?**


At O\&K, our mission is to ***Think Beyond Impossible***. We encourage a mindset that challenges boundaries, transforms the impossible into achievable outcomes, and drives innovation forward.

**Is that you?** Do you believe in making the impossible possible?

 **Job purpose**


Responsible for the management of obtaining and processing customer orders and inquiries with the objective of maintaining a good customer service relationship.

**Duties and responsibilities**

* Answer calls from customers regarding inquiries or orders and enter all orders in AS400\.
* Answer all inquiries from customers in a timely manner.
* Assist with client request or resolve escalated issues as needed.
* Handle, maintain, and build lasting relationship with assigned territory/accounts.
* Follow up with possible leads to obtain additional business.
* Enter and issue new purchase orders.
* Review complaints from customers and recommend corrective action.
* Work with production scheduler to verify and ensure production schedule can meet requested delivery date. Along with client requesting earlier or delay in delivery.
* Plan shipments, create, and provide shipping instructions to Shipping and QA department.
* Schedule empty carrier return.
* Provide mill certification and BOL to customer.
* Review and assess shipment prices from previous day before issuing invoice to customer.
* Enter data and print out New M\-Spec Request Form
* Review and verify the M\-Spec sheet for correct size, grade, mill source, wire type, coating and coil weight.
* Manage overall and storing inventory from order adjustments.
* Maintain Rod Inventory. Verify the requested size, weight, grade of material was delivered in good condition.
* Review open orders, assess past orders, and adjust transfer orders.
* Maintain close relationship with outside sales.
* Support Outside sales and accounting with pricing or invoice issues.
* Answer and transfer company calls to the appropriate department as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business management, advertising, marketing or other related courses.
* Detail oriented and ability to manage multiple projects/accounts.
* Ability to communicate effectively and professionally, strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products. (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Function independently with limited supervision in performing all job duties and responsibilities.
* Experience in delivering client\-focused solutions and time management skills to meet client needs.
* Excellent customer service skills and an ability to work with all levels of staff, management, and clients.
* Experience in the manufacturing field.

**Working conditions**


This job operates in a production office environment, including offices, warehouse, and storerooms. Maybe exposed to elements such as noise, dust, fumes and odors.

**Physical requirements**

* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to see, talk, and hear. The employee frequently is required to sit or stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands.
* Will be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) in posted areas of the plant, including safety glasses, ear plugs, high visibility safety vest, and safety metatarsal shoes.
* Able to pull/lift between 20\-50 lbs in and office setting.

**Direct reports**


None

 **We offer...**

* A GREAT Team\-Orientated Culture
* Competitive Wages
* Health, Dental, and Optical Insurance
* 401k with Yearly Employer Profit Share
* Short\-Term Disability and Life Insurance (AD\&D)
* Vacation Time / Paid Sick Leave / Paid Leave / 9 Paid Holidays
* $250/yr Uniform Allowance and two $150/yr Safety Shoe Allowance

  

You've considered the rest. Now work for the best!  

  

**O\&K and E\-verify**  

O\&K is an equal opportunity employer. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law.  

  

O\&K validates right to work using E\-Verify. O\&K will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: DTC Account Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**About Blue Wheel**

Blue Wheel is a new breed of omni\-channel digital commerce agency that services brands from "click to ship." Our integrated approach combines front\-end marketing, advertising, and creative services with back\-end operational support and fulfillment across direct\-to\-consumer, eRetail, and marketplace channels.


Our teams help brands grow across today's most important digital commerce platforms by combining deep channel expertise with proprietary technology, including our reporting and analytics platform, Companion. As we continue to expand our direct\-to\-consumer practice, we are looking for an experienced Paid Media Account Manager to join our team.




**The Opportunity**


As a Paid Media Account Manager, you will serve as the primary strategic partner and main point of contact for a portfolio of DTC clients. In this role, you will be responsible for managing client relationships, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring the successful execution of paid media strategies that drive growth across channels such as search, social, and programmatic.


This role is highly collaborative and requires strong communication, project management, and strategic thinking skills. While you will work closely with internal specialists across Paid Media, Creative, Analytics, Owned and Earned Marketing, you will be responsible for ensuring all initiatives align with client goals and are delivered effectively.


The ideal candidate has strong experience within the paid media ecosystem and understands how the different components of performance marketing\-campaign strategy, creative, audience targeting, and on\-site experience\-work together to drive results.




**What You'll Do**

**Client LeadershipRelationship Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of DTC clients, building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor on paid media strategy
* Lead regular client meetings, including performance reviews, strategic discussions, and quarterly business reviews
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication, strategic recommendations, and clear performance insights

**StrategyPerformance Oversight**

* Translate client business goals into actionable paid media strategies across platforms including Google, Meta, TikTok, and other emerging channels
* Monitor account performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scale, and overall return on investment
* Budget planning and performance forecasting by leveraging historical data, platform insights, and scenario\-based thinking to guide investment decisions and growth strategies
* Connect cross\-functional teams to ensure strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels are aligned, cohesive, and driving toward shared client goals; translate these efforts into clear, digestible, and actionable recommendations
* Provide data\-driven insights and recommendations based on performance trends, testing results, and platform dynamics
* Stay informed on platform updates and best practices across paid media and the broader digital marketing landscape as well as within the client's industry




**Cross\-Functional CollaborationAccount Growth**

* Coordinate closely with internal teams across Paid Media, Analytics, Creative, etc to ensure successful execution of client strategies
* Manage timelines, priorities, and deliverables across multiple accounts while ensuring work is delivered on schedule
* Identify opportunities to expand services and drive incremental growth for client accounts
* Contribute to internal best practices and knowledge sharing across the Paid Media team
* Proactively identify opportunities to retain and grow client revenue by uncovering gaps, recommending upsells, and introducing new solutions that align with client goals and broader business objectives




**Who You Are**

* A strong communicator who can confidently lead conversations with clients and internal teams
* Highly organized and capable of managing multiple projects and client priorities simultaneously
* A strategic thinker who understands how paid media levers impact business performance
* Collaborative and comfortable working across multiple teams and stakeholders
* Curious and proactive about evolving trends and opportunities within the digital marketing landscape

**Desired SkillsExperience**

* 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, or eCommerce account management
* Experience developing or contributing to paid media strategies and media plans across platforms such as Google, Meta, TikTok, and other digital channels; strong understanding of how budget allocation, targeting, and creative drive performance outcomes
* Experience managing or supporting paid media campaigns across search and social
* Previous experience in a client\-facing account management role, ideally within an agency or consulting environment
* Strong understanding of performance marketing including campaign structure, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance analytics
* Proactive and detail\-oriented, with a strong ability to connect the dots across media, creative, and on\-site performance data to deliver cohesive, actionable insights
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients and projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong project management and organizational skills
* Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Experience managing budgets, forecasts, and performance reporting preferred
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field preferred
* Agency or consulting experience is strongly preferred

**Blue Wheel operates and hires in the following states: CT, CO, FL, ID, IL, KS, MI, MN, NJ, NY, OR, PA, TN, TX, and WA**

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future\-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp!



This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast\-paced, mission\-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world.


**What** **we're** **looking for:**



Nexamp is looking to hire a Commercial Customer Success Manager (titled Account Manager internally) to join the Customer Experience team! You will play a pivotal role in managing and growing relationships with Nexamp's business customers, educating them on community solar and guiding them through program options and value\-added propositions. You'll manage assigned accounts, resolve billing, credit, and service issues, and effectively de\-escalate and resolve conflicts to maintain high customer satisfaction. You'll represent the voice of the customer across cross\-functional teams, including actively supporting the collections team and processes as needed.



You will be hybrid out of our Boston or Chicago offices. You will report to the Director, Customer Experience \& Retention.


**What you'll do:**


* Manage a portfolio of business customers, building trusted relationships, providing proactive outreach and periodic business reviews. Serve as a primary point of contact for account status, savings, billing, and program performance.
* Lead the resolution of complex customer issues related to billing, payments, crediting, utility impacts, invoice discrepancies, back billing, delayed billing cycles, and escalations by partnering across Revenue Operations, Billing, Treasury Operations, Accounting, Asset Management, Product, and Energy Sales.
* Own collections efforts for managed accounts by escalating aged balances and payment issues with customers, brokers, and internal Energy Sales partners, while resolving remittance, payment application, and other account\-specific issues.
* Guide commercial customers through billing\-model and account transitions, including UCB/net crediting adoption, account changes, one\-time credit transfers, and other customer\-specific solutions that improve payment experience and reduce friction.
* Own Direct ACH setup for eligible commercial customers by confirming fit, coordinating VRN assignment and customer communications, sending required bank documentation, tracking setup progress, and confirming first payment receipt.
* Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and account\-management records across Salesforce, Zuora, and related tools; use reporting, dashboards, and spreadsheets to analyze account activity, explain customer impacts, and generate actionable insights for internal stakeholders and customers.
* Own account\-management enablement for account\-managed and anchor customers by providing clear case guidance, improving SOPs and templates, and helping shape scalable account\-management processes, handoffs, and customer communications.


**What you'll bring:**


* 3\+ years of experience in account management, client success, or customer service.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with business customers, communicate effectively, and manage complex issues.
* Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, prioritize competing tasks, maintain attention to detail, and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in strategic outreach, stakeholder engagement, and negotiation.
* Working knowledge of billing processes, financial principles, and solar credits, rebates, and incentives.
* Proficiency using multiple software systems for account management, including Salesforce CRM.
* Experience within the solar or renewable energy sector is a plus.
* Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
* Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.
* Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality.
* Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions.
* Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry.
* Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.


***If you don't meet 100% of the above qualifications, but see yourself contributing, please apply.***


***At Nexamp, our mission is to build the future of energy so it is clean, simple, and accessible for all. We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. By encouraging a culture where ideas and decisions come from all people, we believe it will help us grow, innovate, and be a part of environmental and social change.***


**You'll** **love working here because:**



Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer\-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. **JOB DESCRIPTION**

Our mission is simple but powerful: **help homeowners and businesses save money while making a real difference for the planet.**

With lightning\-fast installations, competitive compensation, and a company culture that genuinely supports your growth, we’re leading the charge in the solar revolution.

We operate differently from most solar companies. We value stability and fairness, offering **uncapped commission opportunities, bonuses, and performance\-based incentives.** Our compensation structure rewards hard work while providing the consistency, training, and support needed to build a long\-term career.

**NEW BATTERY\-FIRST PROGRAM JUST LAUNCHED**

Daylight’s new **battery\-first solar program** puts energy storage at the center of the homeowner experience.

Customers can get a battery paired with solar through a simple monthly payment, with **no upfront equipment cost or system ownership required.**

This battery\-first approach gives homeowners greater energy independence, backup power, and protection from rising utility costs—while giving our sales representatives a differentiated offer built around one of the fastest\-growing needs in home energy.

**WHY LUCID / DAYLIGHT?**

* **$60,000–$275,000\+ potential annual earnings**
* Uncapped commissions
* Weekly and monthly bonuses
* Performance incentives
* Referral and team bonuses
* Flexible full\-time and part\-time schedules
* Advancement opportunities
* Professional sales training and ongoing coaching

**THE JOB**

**This is a true door\-to\-door sales position.**

You’ll spend your day in the field **knocking doors, starting conversations with homeowners, identifying opportunities, and helping qualified customers go solar.**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* Educate homeowners on the benefits of solar energy
* Knock doors and generate your own leads—we’ll teach you how
* Conduct personalized consultations and present tailored solar solutions
* Follow up with prospects and close deals with confidence
* Use CRM tools to stay organized and track your activity
* Participate in team meetings, training, and ongoing development

**WHO SUCCEEDS HERE?** *No solar experience? No problem. We train you.****We’re looking for people with:***

* Confidence when talking to strangers
* Thick skin and resilience
* A competitive mindset
* A strong work ethic
* Coachability
* Reliable transportation
* The ability to stay motivated through rejection — If hearing **“no”** makes you quit, this probably isn’t for you.

If it makes you **knock on the next door harder, we want to meet you.**

**TERRITORY**

**Massachusetts \& Illinois**

Field\-based positions covering designated residential territories outside major city centers. **Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates.**

**SECOND\-CHANCE OPPORTUNITIES**

We believe in giving motivated people a chance to build a career. **Candidates with prior criminal records are encouraged to apply.**

**GROW WITH US**

We’re building a sales organization with room to grow. Top performers can earn opportunities to advance into **Team Lead, Sales Manager, and Leadership positions.**

**READY TO GET AFTER IT?**

If you’re hungry, competitive, and ready to see what you’re capable of earning, **apply today.Knock doors. Close deals. Build your future.**

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $275,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Opportunities for advancement
* Relocation assistance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  

Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high\-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP\-TARTS and RICE KRISPIE TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start\-up, our division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category\-shaping innovations for tomorrow and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.
  
  

We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!
  
  

TheExecutive Assistant (EA) – Sales for our Accelerator Division working from our Wells Street, Chicago office, is responsible for providing high\-level administrative support to senior executives. This role involves managing schedules, organizing meetings, handling communications, and ensuring that the executives time is efficiently allocated. The EA must possess strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
  
  

The ideal candidate has an interest in leadership effectiveness and business\-related topics, specifically in Sales. They have experience managing complexity and ambiguity on scale and know how to provide excellent customer service. They will have outstanding communication and negotiation skills and enjoy overcoming challenges in a team/collaborative environment. This role will also manage two other Executive Assistants supporting the broader Sales organization.
  
  

What are we looking for?
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, or a related field is preferred.
* At least 3 years of experience in an executive assistant or administrative role is typically required.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Problem\-solving and critical thinking abilities.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
* Ability to adapt to a dynamic, fast\-paced work environment.
* A professional demeanor and the ability to interact with high\-level executives and stakeholders.
* Excellent organization and analytical skills, comfortable managing competing priorities and leading projects and initiatives.
* Effectively switch between tasks and adapt to changing priorities, while efficiently and effectively delivering results.
* Working knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, MS Teams.
* Ability and interest in learning new tools and systems and managing frequent changes and upgrades.
* Integrity in handling confidential information sensitively.
* Comfortable providing feedback, directing, and engaging with senior leaders.
* Sensitive about cultures, and different ways of being and thinking.
* Curious about business, in general, and how decisions are made in global organizations.
* Experience supporting a Sales organization is preferred – including an understanding of how to communicate externally with key stakeholders and customers


What will be your key responsibilities?
  
  

* Maintain, organize, prioritize and resolve conflicts with the executive’s calendar by scheduling meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.
* Prioritize and resolve conflicts regarding scheduling, ensuring the executives time is efficiently utilized.
* Interface with leadership, internal staff, clients, key stakeholders, high\-profile individuals, and important personal contacts.
* Manage incoming and outgoing communications based on Sr leader preferences and communication styles ensuring timely responses and follow\-ups.
* Prepare and edit correspondence, reports, presentations, and other documents as needed.
* Arrange domestic and international travel – arrange flights, hotels transfers.
* Plan and coordinate internal and external meeting logistics, conferences, meeting rooms, catering, and guest arrival arrangements.
* Attend meetings, take notes, and track action items.
* Event planning that includes hotel blocks, group transportation, property search, costs, meeting invites, negotiations and decision making.
* Assist with or lead specific projects and initiatives as directed by the executive, ensuring deadlines and objectives are met.
* Engage with planning and execution of the National Sales Meeting
* Assist with the preparation and tracking of budgets, expenses, and invoices.
* Process reimbursements and ensure adherence to company policies for financial matters.
* Collaborate with other administrative assistants, staff, and departments to ensure smooth workflow and efficiency.
* Manage internal and external communications for the executive, facilitating seamless interaction between stakeholders.
* Managing 2\-3 direct reports of other Executive Assistants within the function to provide guidance and alignment.
* Other duties as required are based on capacity assessment


What can you expect from Mars?
  
  

* Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
* Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
* A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in\-house Mars University.
* An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT GREYSTAR**

  

  

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional\-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia\-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36\.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world\-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit www.greystar.com.

  

  

**JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

This role supports and assists the Community Manager in overseeing and managing the financial and operational facets of the community by completing accounting and bookkeeping tasks, preparing monthly close\-out and financial reports, processing invoices for payment, collecting rent, fees, and other payments, completing bank deposits, dispositions, and account reconciliations, and using the property management software to record, track, and report on all financial workings of the community.
**JOB DESCRIPTION**


* Completes the daily transactions and tasks related to the financial operation of the community by collecting and posting rent, fees, and other payments, preparing daily bank deposits and reconciling bank accounts, preparing financial reports, and processing invoices and payables.
* Operates the property management software (Yardi/OneSite) and completes transactions by entering all required fields correctly and by completing updates and back\-ups to ensure the integrity of the system.
* Reviews resident files and accounting records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease to maximize revenue.
* Reviews and submits invoices from vendors, contractors, and service providers for payment by reconciling work performed or products purchased, obtaining community manager approval, coding charges to appropriate Chart of Account codes, and managing communication between the vendor/contractor, accounting, and the client/owner as needed.
* Follows the Company’s established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the community as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.
* Processes resident move\-outs by reviewing lease terms and notice requirements, applying appropriate deposit and lease cancellation fees, if applicable, and processing the disposition in accordance with established procedures and legal requirements.
* Promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Acts as the on\-site supervisor in the absence of the community manager by organizing and delegating daily work, coordinating maintenance and make\-ready tasks with the maintenance supervisor, and managing the operation of the community in compliance with Company policies, procedures, and business practices.
* Assists in managing the client/owner relationship by meeting with the owners, conducting community tours, providing updates and information about the community’s performance, and responding to owner requests as needed.
* May assist and/or support leasing and marketing efforts by greeting prospective residents, gathering information about the prospect via the Guest Card, showing ready apartments and models, closing and obtaining the lease deposit, and assisting the prospective resident in completing the rental application and credit verification.


**BASIC KNOWLEDGE \& QUALIFICATIONS:**
--------------------------------------


* 1\-3 years minimum of relevant experience in residence life and/or property management that demonstrates the application of community management, sales, marketing, and customer service background sufficient to assist in managing the day\-to\-day operations of an apartment community, resolve customer complaints and issues, complete financial records, documents, and reports, increase sales revenues, and coordinate the work of a team.
* Understanding of lease terms and lease enforcement, including collections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail\-oriented and self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and as a collaborative member of a team.

**SPECIALIZED SKILLS:**
-----------------------


* Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.
* Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents.
* Strong proficiency in using property management software (Yardi, OneSite, Entrata, etc.).

**TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**
------------------------------


* Team members work in an office environment but also may have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperature, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous. Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior and interior parts of the property and amenities.
* Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior and interior parts of the community and amenities.
* Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty (20\) pounds independently and fifty (50\) pounds with assistance.
